none: PAS CAM-801F55: Roman Coin : A Copper-alloy Contemporary Copy of a Nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy contemporary copy of a nummus of the House of Constantine. Mint unknown, c.AD330-340, (Reece period 17). Reverse shows Victory left on prow. See Ref. RIC VII, p.138, c.f.256. Obverse shows helmeted bust left. Obverse legend reads (CONSTANTINOPOLIS). Mint mark is -//...(crescent and dot). Die axis is 6 o'clock, weight is 1.32g, diameter is 15.35mm
